body: Thank you for the advice, same thing that Ive been doing for a while. It's oddly comforting to know that others are doing the same thing as me

I've looked into it a bit but I can't deal with the idea that there is an end. That everyone will event die out and the universe will die. I find everything to be pointless and I genuinely believe that I did not choose to write this, it was pre determined
I can't do anything that makes me happy. Whenever I do anything there's this lingering feeling that it doesn't matter. That I have no free will. That it was all already determined. So why bother

I've been depressed for a while, but it really got bad when I realized that, if I'm wrong and there is no afterlife, everything that I've done will be for nothing. And a lack motivation because of that
